repaymentNotes: Interest accrues at 4% per annum on a reducing balance during repayment
Statutory annual ledger maintenance fee is KES 1,000 per year until the loan is cleared
Grace period of 1 year after completion of studies before repayment begins
Minimum monthly repayment is KES 1,500 or 10% of gross salary, whichever is higher
Defaulting past the grace period attracts a statutory penalty of KES 5,000 per month
Maximum repayment period is 15 years from the start of repayment
Employers are legally required to deduct HELB repayments from salary and remit via helb.co.ke
source: Higher Education Loans Board (HELB Act Cap 213A & helb.co.ke)
